description: Player character v2: an adult man (short dark hair, stubble) in a charcoal T-shirt and shorts, barefoot, A-pose base. Occupation-neutral; the three armour kits dress him, and character creation tints skin, garments, iris and lips through baked masks (assets/characters/survivor/look). The woman was survivor v1 (Meshy, 24 joints), which cannot use v2 clips or kits; a female v2 base waits for an owner-approved concept sheet.
